integrity_notes: Positive complete-tree certificates and two independent finite implementations are included; full publication priority is not certified. Self-review only, without independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact Littlestone classification is proved only for one through seven labels; the seven-label upper bound uses finite exhaustive recursion on all reachable partial orders. No statement about dimensions for more than seven labels.
title: The first factorial information-bound failure for comparison shattering of permutations
